title: [PC, Steam] Kingdom Come: Deliverance II $35.98 (60% off) @ Fanatical
body:
Deal: [PC, Steam] Kingdom Come: Deliverance II $35.98 (60% off) @ Fanatical

[Quantum Quokka] I once sold all my bandages and had to make potions through the night to survive a bleed from an arrow I received at Nebakov.. .
[mordinhoz] Hopefully warhorse introduce cross save soon. Want to continue my ps5 save which is half way through on PC.
[Quantum Quokka] Can you put the PS5 drive in an external reader and copy the save file?
[Quantum Quokka] Just had a look: There is no official method or supported third-party tool to convert PS5 save data to a PC-readable format for Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2.
[Treepod] I agree that this is an excellent game and an excellent price. I'd hesitate to compare it to the Witcher and Skyrim though. There's a strong focus on realism and it's very slow compared to something like Skyrim.
It's an awesome experience but it's probably worth watching some videos or reading about it to determine if it's your type of game.
[NedStark102] I agree, but at the same time I think there'd be a decent crossover between people who enjoyed Skyrim and people who would enjoy KCD. Just as long as you go in knowing it's much different in terms of pacing and realism, and with the knowledge that there's a much steeper learning curve. Fantastic game though.
[Vladdo] Much like KCD1, I really tried to get into this but the combat is something my brain doesn't compute with. Even a lowly fight, I'd just get smashed every time which induced a rage quit and uninstall. Frustration helll.
[NedStark102] The combat definitely takes some getting used to, especially in the early game where Henry literally doesn't know how to fight (and subsequently gets the crap kicked out of him). It's a fun progression when you get to the point of parrying and riposting multiple enemies though.
[Toporo] Definitely watch a video or guide on early game how to get started, as well as the mechanics such as hunger, fatigue, crime, no NPC respawn etc. Otherwise you'll just get frustrated as soon as the prologue section is completed.
[mordinhoz] I agree. You really gotta have a darks souls like mentally at the start weird enough.
[SickDmith] Never understood that concept - non-physical game being sold out.
[Rambomst] Third-party stores don't get unlimited keys.
[Zalur] Ah crap I just bought a copy but didn't realise I already had it on steam. If anyone wants it for say $20 send me a pm
[BargainWizard] 1c more for $35.99 @ gog
https://www.gog.com/en/game/kingdom_come_deliverance_ii_roya…
and $12 more for $47.99 for the royal edition which i think is the best value
https://www.gog.com/en/game/kingdom_come_deliverance_ii_roya…
[SickDmith] Bummer… I would buy from GOG if see it there.
[Commander Shepard] I jumped this game recently. I did hear about the game prior. But a tour guide mentioned the game when I was visiting Kuttenberg a couple of months ago.
I am now 30+ hours in. This has been an excellent game so far. I haven't felt this level of immersion since I playing Oblivion in 2006 and Fallout 3 in 2008. I had a bit of trouble learning the swordplay and building up some money/gear at the start. But very satisfying once you get there. Highly recommend.
[SickDmith] Is base game enough or I need to get some DLCs?
